name: CourtListener
description: Search U.S. case law, dockets and judges, look up citations, and get alerts on new court filings and opinions with CourtListener by Free Law Project.

events.d: Get a court opinion by ID with its type, author and full text.
Get a court case docket by ID with its court, parties summary, dates and case details.
Get a case law opinion cluster by ID with its case name, citations, judges and opinions.
Search case law, federal dockets and filings, judges or oral arguments with filters.
Find every legal citation in a block of text, or one citation by volume, reporter and page.
Create a saved search alert that notifies you of new opinions or federal cases matching a query.
Delete a saved search alert by its ID.
Subscribe to a case docket to get alerts when new filings are added.
Unsubscribe from a case docket by deleting its docket alert.
Runs when a new case law opinion is added, optionally for a chosen court and status.
